rca_of_issue: Original bug (iter 37): products_master.py:162 used `and` to require BOTH '/thumb/' AND '-thumb-' substrings in the thumbnail URL before rewriting to big variant. 91mobiles autosuggest URLs only contain '-thumb-1.jpg' filename suffix (no '/thumb/' directory), so the guard was never truthy and blurry thumbs were shipped. Fix: change `and` → `or`. Additionally, main agent purged 3 stale rows from products_master_cache MongoDB collection so first search after restart re-shaped rows through the corrected path.
